tools.name: calculate_discounted_price
tools.description: Calculates the final price after applying a discount percentage to the original price, rounded to 2 decimal places. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_investment_return
tools.description: Calculates the return on investment using compound interest formula. Returns the final amount and total return given an initial deposit, annual interest rate (as a percentage), and investment period in years. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: future_investment_value
tools.description: Calculates the future value of an investment using compound interest formula: FV = PV × (1 + r)^n, where r is annual interest rate and n is years. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_interest
tools.description: Calculates simple interest using the formula: Interest = Principal × Rate × Time. Rate should be provided as a percentage and time in years. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_discount
tools.description: Calculates the discounted price after applying a percentage discount to the original price. Returns both discount amount and final price. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_tax
tools.description: Calculates the tax amount by applying a tax rate percentage to an income or price amount. Formula: amount × (rate / 100). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: project_investment_growth
tools.description: Projects investment growth over years using compound interest with optional annual additions and inflation adjustment. Formula: FV = PV(1+r)^n + PMT×[((1+r)^n - 1)/r], with each annual addition made at the end of the year. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: compound_interest
tools.description: Calculates compound interest using the formula A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt), where A is final amount, P is principal, r is annual rate, n is compounding frequency per year, and t is time in years. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: cagr
tools.description: Calculates the Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) using the formula CAGR = (end_value/start_value)^(1/years) - 1. Returns the annualized rate of return as a percentage. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_dividend_per_share
tools.description: Calculates the dividend per share by dividing total dividend payout by number of outstanding shares. Returns the quarterly dividend amount per share rounded to 2 decimal places. (cost: 1 credit)
